title: Equipement obligatoire — Grand Raid de La Réunion 2026
claims: The 2026 mandatory equipment list requires a head torch with spare batteries, at least 1.5 litres of water, a whistle and a charged mobile phone with the Sara Event app.
For the Diagonale des Fous the list requires two elastic adhesive bandages at least 2.5 m long and 6 to 8 cm wide.

The list requires a constant food reserve sufficient to reach the next aid station, a waterproof hooded jacket with taped seams (a windproof shell is expressly insufficient), a long-sleeved technical warm layer and a reusable cup.
The list requires an original or certified digital identity document and a survival blanket of at least 1.4 m by 2 m.
All listed items apply to the Diagonale des Fous as mandatory, not optional.
